reportMissingReq(context, node, { indent, insertPos, missingStory }): - If missingStory is false, inserts `// @req \n` before insertPos and reports missingAnnotation with missing: "@req". - Else, only reports missingAnnotation. - reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef): - Gets sourceCode and parent from node.parent. - Calls getBranchAnnotationInfo to compute missingStory/missingReq/indent/insertPos. - Creates an actions array with two entries (story and req) and forEaches them; when missing is true, calls corresponding report function. - traceability.notes:
All requirements and acceptance criteria for Story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are fully implemented and verified.
The `traceability/require-branch-annotation` rule exists and is wired into the plugin; it enforces annotations on all significant branch types defined by the story. Comment association logic correctly handles standard branches, SwitchCase, catch, and else-if branches, including formatter-driven layouts (e.g., Prettier). Annotation parsing treats @supports as a valid alternative to separate @story and @req tags, satisfying REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE. Configuration via branchTypes is supported, with robust invalid-config error reporting matching the story’s specification.
Comprehensive tests validate core behavior, nested structures, configurable scope, error messages, and performance on large, nested branch-heavy files. Documentation in docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md explains usage, behavior, options, and includes examples consistent with the implementation. A fresh `npm test -- --runInBand --verbose` run confirms all relevant tests pass, providing strong evidence the story is fully delivered.
Therefore, the assessment status for docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md is PASSED.
